sloka: तासां विलपमानानां तथा राक्षसयोषिताम् ।ज्येष्ठा पत्नी प्रिया दीना भर्तारं समुदैक्षत ।। ६.११४.१ ।।
transliteration: tāsāṁ vilapamānānāṁ tathā rākṣasayoṣitām ।jyeṣṭhā patnī priyā dīnā bhartāraṁ samudaikṣata ।। 6.114.1 ।।

translations.english: Then from among the wives lamenting, the first wife, dear to Ravana gazed at her husband lamenting piteously.
